card.name: Disclaimer and licence wording on websites
card.fires_on: Words in website disclaimer, copyright and licence notices, such as 'images', 'informative', 'intended', 'incorporate' and 'included'. It marks the word just before the notice's next phrase continues.

modes.label: Health disclaimer
modes.description: Words in a notice saying the information is meant to be informative and educational.

modes.description: Words about images, reproduction or incorporating material in licence or permission text.

modes.label: Other site text
modes.description: Single words in site menus or descriptions of case studies and notes.
